topLevel.why: Y gives one part per story or essay. X cuts 'Human Readable' into four parts and 'Chicken Little' into four, splits 'Power Punctuation!' mid-story at block 1620, and makes stand-alone parts of afterwords and the Epoch ad. Y's only flaw is folding the title page, contents and dedication in with Coulton's introduction.

gists.why: Y's section gists are usually more specific and fit passages 1, 2 and 8 more closely. X's gists fit better for passage 3, where Y's section gist is really a summary of the whole story, and for passage 7. The other passages are roughly even.

weldedParts.why: Joins the title, contents, dedication and publication-history front matter with Jonathan Coulton's separately authored introduction.

overall.why: Y's top level matches the collection's real story-by-story structure. X's fragmentation of several stories into mid-story parts makes it a much worse map, and the gist quality is close enough not to offset that.
